newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela holds four Europeans on drug trafficking.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela holds four Europeans on drug trafficking.

text.p: Four Europeans, including a Spanish woman seven-months pregnant, were arrested for attempting to smuggle 30 pounds (14 kg) of cocaine to Europe, Venezuelan authorities said on Wednesday.

The woman, Ana Maria Martin, 27, and Salvador Trayana, 30, of Spain were stopped on Wednesday morning when they tried to board a flight at Margarita Island airport carrying 23 pounds (10 kg) of cocaine hidden in sportswear, Lt. Col. Fernando Fernandez of the National Guard said.

Two Britons were also arrested at the Caribbean island's airport on Tuesday evening as they prepared to take a flight to Manchester, England. Simon Walker, 21, and Michael Kane, 43, were carrying about nine pounds (4 kg) in waistcoats worn beneath their clothing, Fernandez said.
Margarita Island, which lies just off Venezuela's northeastern coast, is the country's main tourist attraction, drawing about 200,000 foreign tourists each year.
Fernandez said authorities on the island had seized about 110 pounds (50 kg) of cocaine in the last six weeks from foreigners trying to smuggle the drugs abroad.
